title: Recipe Control Upgrade
text: Right-click the held plate to configure nine ghost product samples. Clicking consumes nothing; an empty cursor clears a sample, and another item replaces it. Use filled fluid containers to filter fluid products.

A whitelist permits the entire recipe when any possible product matches. A blacklist rejects the entire recipe when any possible product matches. An empty whitelist stops production; an empty blacklist allows all recipes.
Controls reaction pools, catalysis chambers, starlight conversion and orb lava production. Disabled work pauses and resumes when permitted. Storage and transfers are unaffected.
